claims.text: Terry K. Patton, professor emeritus at Midwestern State University, has chaired FASAB since April 2026; the Board also comprises R. Scott Bell, Eric S. Berman, Robert Dacey, Diane L. Dudley, Billy Morehead and David A. Vaudt.
